name: Import leads (bulk)
summary: Import a large CSV/TSV/SSV file of lead records (insert or update). Upload the file, watch the job, then open the failures/warnings file if any rows had problems.
whenToUse: Loading or updating many leads at once. For one-off small updates use 'Sync leads' instead. The first row must be a header of REST API field names (e.g. email,firstName,lastName).
notes: File must be under 10 MB and start with a header row of REST API names.
Records are matched/updated by the dedupe field (default: email). Use lookupField 'id' to only update existing leads.
Optional: imported leads can be added to a static list (listId).
The job runs asynchronously; check back in a few seconds/minutes.
After completion, open 'Failures' and/or 'Warnings' to see exactly which rows had issues and why.

form.name: file
form.label: Lead data file
form.hint: CSV/TSV/SSV under 10 MB. First row = REST API field names (email,firstName,lastName, …).

form.name: lookupField
form.label: Match/update by field

options.label: email — insert or update by email

form.hint: Leave as email to create new leads or update existing ones.

form.name: listId
form.label: Also add to a static list (optional)
form.hint: Static list ID — imported leads are added to this list in addition to being created/updated.

form.name: partitionName
form.label: Partition (optional, advanced)
form.hint: Only for workspace setups — the partition to import into (see 'List partitions' in the Leads group).
